## The problem

What you are trying to do and what gets in the way.

## The proposal

What you would like ynm to do. If it changes a design decision recorded under `docs/adr`, say
which one; a change of decision becomes a new ADR.

## Alternatives

Other ways you considered, including doing it outside ynm.
